title: idSign
tagline: Trustless eSignature, escrowPayments & Reusable DID - abstracting signatures into tamper-proof, onchain records
description: idSign is a decentralized e-signature, escrow payment & identity protocol revolutionizing digital trust by abstracting signatures into tamper-proof, onchain records, and transforming DIDs from a recurring hurdle into a reusable one-time process, addressing the privacy needs of the market by storing documents on multiple encrypted nodes!
how_its_made:
idSign works from telegram, WebApp or through manual APIs. We use LIT protocol for encryption
Solidity Smart Contracts for our protocol. Filecoin for storage of encrypted files or parts, and mint SBTs for each on-chain verification. We also have DAO smart contracts and a Governance Layer for dispute resulution, attestation, etc..
We use a self-hosted A.I. LLM on hugging face for document generation.
